page.layout: One printed title page, full width, centred lines from top to bottom; a woodcut engraving in the centre below the imprint lines; handwritten inscriptions in the margins (left and right) and a library stamp, which are not printed text.

main_text.l: Historiae tam Saeculares quam Ecclesiasticae, ea diligentia atque fide perscriptae
sunt, vt non solùm Antiquitatum Studiosis, sed Theologis cum primis &
Tomus vnus in duas partes tributus,
CVM GLOSSIS RERVM ET VERBORVM DIFFICILIORVM, QVIBVS
nonnunquam historiae illustrantur, familiarum indagantur origines, ritus prisci
Omnia nunc primùm edita ex Bibliotheca
Ex Officina Wolffgangi Richteri, curante Iohanne Theobaldo

page.notes: Handwritten marginal inscriptions (left: "Oratorii Sanmm aglorian..."; right: "Ex dono D. D. Lud. Fouquet Epi Agath.") and a red library stamp ("Bibliothèque de la Ville de Lyon") are not printed text and are omitted. Woodcut engraving: a winged figure with a crown holding a staff, perched on a bird, with a shield below. The line "Oratorii" and handwriting are uncertain in reading and are not transcribed. Running head, page number and catchword are absent.
